meta.name: COCO Student Living & Study Ecosystem DNA
meta.description: A vibrant, contemporary Gen-Z student living, room finding and collaborative study platform combining Airbnb-grade trust with Linear/Notion modern clarity.

neutral.usage: Lightest for frosted glass cards and app scaffolds; mid tones for borders and subtle chip backgrounds; darkest for high-contrast crisp typography.

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant with vibrant tinted badges and high-contrast primary CTA buttons

font_families.heading: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Geometric sans with humanist warmth, tight tracking on headings for punchy readability, generous line height on descriptions.

spacing.section_rhythm: 16px between compact elements, 24px between distinct functional modules, 32px below hero banners.

layout.grid_system: 12-column responsive fluid grid with mobile single-column card stack
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with subtle asymmetric badge accents

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px border (#E2E8F0) on light cards, translucent white on glass overlays

elevation.shadow_style: layered soft diffused with tinted button glows
elevation.depth_cues: ambient soft shadows, frosted glass blur layers, and floating navigation elevation

iconography.style: rounded geometric dual-state (outlined inactive, filled vibrant active)

motion.entrance_pattern: fade-scale in with slight upward translation
motion.philosophy: snappy, responsive, micro-haptic feedback without distracting inertia

components.button_style: Pill & smooth rounded-14 buttons with gradient fills, subtle glow shadow, and scale tap feedback
components.input_style: Filled clean slate-50/white inputs with 1.2px border, focusing to primary indigo glow
components.card_style: Frosted or pure white rounded-20 cards with crisp image containers, floating badge overlays, and soft ambient shadow
components.navigation_pattern: Floating glass bottom dock with pill active indicators and status notification dots
components.modal_style: Bottom sheet with rounded-t-24 header, drag handle, and transparent backdrop blur
components.list_style: Separated card rows with rounded corners and clear chevron cues
components.component_notes: Tag pills have 10% opacity colored backgrounds with 100% saturation foreground text for instant scannability.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A vibrant digital campus town square and trusted hospitality concierge

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents (gradient badges, soft mesh headers, ambient glows)
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous breathing room around cards and section headers
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: top-heavy hero banners transitioning into clean structured cards
visual_language.focal_strategy: high-contrast price badges and primary action buttons as immediate anchors
visual_language.contrast_level: high typographic contrast with soft background transitions
visual_language.texture_usage: smooth frosted glass backdrop-filter blur and subtle gradient mesh

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic scale + color weight + spatial elevation
composition.balance_type: asymmetric dynamic balance with card anchors
composition.flow_direction: vertical scroll with horizontal pill tag filter carousels
composition.grouping_strategy: self-contained card islands with clear perimeter borders and tags
composition.negative_space_role: creates clarity and prevents student cognitive fatigue

imagery.photo_treatment: high-saturation, warm ambient architectural and lifestyle photos with 16:10 or 4:3 aspect ratios
imagery.illustration_style: minimalist isometric line icons and gradient avatar rings
imagery.graphic_elements: pill chips, notification badges, verified checkmarks, compatibility meters
imagery.pattern_usage: subtle dot matrix or radial glow in hero cards
imagery.image_shape: rounded-16 inside cards with smooth clipBehavior

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate visual feedback on tap (scale 0.98, opacity dip)
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: slight upward lift (-2px) and shadow bloom on desktop web
interaction_feel.loading_style: shimmer skeletons and circular branded spinners
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: moderate - on hearts, bookmarks, tabs, and filter pills

brand_voice_in_ui.formality: semi-casual student-friendly with clear financial and rental transparency
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: action-oriented imperative (Đặt Phòng Ngay, Nhắn Tin, Ghép Đôi, Đăng Tin)
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: encouraging illustrations with a clear primary button to explore or reset filters

overview.fallback_strategy: graceful degradation to solid flat containers on low-tier browsers

background_effects.description: Multi-stop radial and linear gradients simulating ambient colored light (indigo, violet, soft sky) behind headers and login cards.

particle_systems.description: None for core functional screens to preserve high performance and clarity.

3d_elements.description: None required for mobile utility app; 2.5D elevation layers used instead.

shader_effects.description: Subtle ShaderMask on brand text titles and active gradient icons.

parallax.depth_range: header card slow scroll vs fast content

scroll_morphing.description: Floating search bar compacts into slim appbar header on scroll.

text_effects.description: Gradient text mask on COCO APP logo and high-priority statistics

cursor_effects.description: Standard responsive touch and mouse pointer.

image_effects.description: Smooth zoom & elevation bloom on card hover/tap

canvas_drawings.description: Circular compatibility match indicator and rating arc bar.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The primary aesthetic impact comes from the harmonious combination of: (1) crisp typography, (2) frosted glass floating navigation dock with active pill indicator, (3) layered ambient drop shadows, and (4) vibrant gradient badges that make listings and roommate profiles immediately feel alive, trustworthy, and modern.
